class.name: VECSEntity
class.brief_description: A lightweight, garbage-collected handle to an ECS entity.
class.description:
[b]VECSEntity[/b] wraps a 64-bit entity id (slot + generation) and gives GDScript access to the entity's components. Handles are transient: validity is checked against the owning world on every access, so a stale handle (from a destroyed or recycled entity) reports [method is_alive] as [code]false[/code] instead of corrupting data.
Obtain handles from [method VECSWorld.create_entity], [method VECSWorld.spawn], [method VECSWorld.spawn_from_data] or query results. Use [method get_component] to get a [VECSComponent] field accessor, or the convenience [method getf] / [method setf] for one-call field access.

method.name: add_component
method.description: Adds a component of type [param type_name] to this entity, initializing its fields from [param fields] (absent fields default to zero). Issuing this inside an iteration is an error; use [method VECSCommandBuffer.add_component] to defer it.

method.name: equals
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param other] refers to the same entity id.

method.name: get_component
method.description: Returns a [VECSComponent] accessor for the component [param type_name], or a null handle if this entity does not have it (or is dead).

method.name: get_component_types
method.description: Returns the names of every component currently attached to this entity.

method.name: get_id
method.description: Returns the entity's raw 64-bit id (slot + generation). Stable across worlds, so it can be used for snapshot loading and network replication.

method.name: getf
method.description: Convenience sugar for [method get_component].get_field: reads a single field in one call. Returns [code]null[/code] if the component or field does not exist.

method.name: has_component
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this entity currently has a component of type [param type_name].

method.name: hash_value
method.description: Returns a stable hash of the entity id, usable as a dictionary key.

method.name: is_alive
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this handle still refers to a live entity in its world.

method.name: remove_component
method.description: Removes the component [param type_name] from this entity, dispatching a REMOVED event. Issuing this inside an iteration is an error; use [method VECSCommandBuffer.remove_component] to defer it.

method.name: setf
method.description: Convenience sugar for [method get_component].set_field: writes a single field in one call and marks it changed. No-op if the component or field does not exist.
